versions.changelog:
- 更新前置条件说明，详细说明 Cue API Key 获取方式及注册奖励调整为一次性送 500 积分，每天再送 10 积分
- 新增“积分不够用怎么办”专节，介绍邀请好友、充值、免费额度等获取积分的方法
- 优化了前置准备部分的表达，使操作流程更清晰
- 删除过时文件 skill-card.md

- Updated the skill description to more clearly list covered scenarios and focus areas, including盘后超级助理, 投顾早盘简报, 高净值财富内容工场, 财经早报, 跨境税务合规展业指南, 债券市场风险监测等核心搭子.
- Replaced the previous “大类资产配置月报” and “基金筛选”搭子 with“债券市场风险监测” in the documented buddy list.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functional steps or operation processes.

Initial release of cue-wealth-advisory skill.

- Enables deep research for "Wealth Advisory" scenarios using Cue, leveraging multi-source public data and sourced conclusions.
- Supports a variety of research modules, including asset allocation reports, market reviews, fund/ETF selection, and compliance guides.
- Requires installation or update of the Cue runner and proper environment setup.
- Explicit credit usage confirmation and real-time selection of research modules are integrated into the workflow.
- Provides source-linked reports, ensuring transparency and credibility of results.
